banner.title: Testnet prototype.
banner.body: No token has value or entitles you to royalties: figures and yields shown are illustrative and unverified. Nothing on this site is an investment offer or advice.
footer.tagline: Humfiverse — music royalty tokenization. Prototype on Ethereum Sepolia, {{year}}.
footer.disclaimer: Not an investment offer. Test tokens have no value.
lang.label: Language
marketplace.title: Music royalty shares, transparent on-chain
marketplace.subtitle: Released catalogues with the royalty history their artist declares, and pre-production tracks funded through milestone escrow. Every listing shows its AI-use disclosure before you buy.
marketplace.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, artist or genre
marketplace.emptyBody: Try a different keyword or clear the filter.
yieldInfo.title: How this is calculated
yieldInfo.formula: Yield % = (royalty paid out over the trailing 12 reported months ÷ token price × total tokens) × 100
yieldInfo.disclaimer: This is a trailing, historical figure — not a promised or guaranteed return. Future royalty income can go down as well as up.
detail.sourcedFrom: Sourced from distributor/PRO statements during onboarding diligence (see Documents tab). Historical income is not a guarantee of future royalty payments.
detail.royaltyDeclared: Declared by the artist at submission, not verified by Humfiverse:
detail.royaltyHistoryPending: No royalty income has been reported for this catalogue yet — this will populate once real distributor/PRO statements are recorded.
detail.priceHistoryLegend: Lowest price of the day, USD
detail.priceHistoryNote: Each day shows the lowest price the token changed hands at for payment (campaign, direct purchase or resale); days without trades keep the last one. Past prices do not indicate future ones.
detail.priceHistoryEmpty: This token has not been traded for payment yet.
detail.priceHistoryUnavailable: Price history unavailable right now: on-chain trades could not be read.
detail.priceHistoryIncomplete: History updating: some transactions have not been read yet.
detail.royaltyReportIntro: Add a real, dated royalty figure for this catalogue — sourced from a distributor or PRO statement you hold. It feeds directly into the trailing-yield calculation and the chart above; nothing here is estimated or invented.
detail.royaltyReportConnectPrompt: Connect a wallet to submit a royalty report.
detail.royaltyReportDisclaimer: Self-reported by the submitting wallet, shown below each entry — not independently verified by Humfiverse.
detail.escrowProse: Funds raised sit in a smart-contract escrow, not a commingled account. Each tranche releases only once the SPV manager confirms that milestone was met. If the funding goal isn’t reached, or a later milestone is never delivered, the unreleased remainder is refunded to contributors pro-rata.
detail.governanceProse: Token holders for this campaign get an advisory vote on a pre-vetted shortlist (e.g. which studio records the session) — the SPV manager retains formal contracting authority. No binding on-chain votes ship in this pilot.
detail.disclosureIntro: Per-element AI-content disclosure, in the DDEX-style categories DSPs are moving toward. This reduces reliance on self-reporting and gives investors a clearer read on platform-policy exposure.
detail.notFoundBody: This asset may have been removed.
buy.platformFeeNote: 2% of the price goes to Humfiverse; the rest goes to the rights holder. You receive every token you pay for.
buy.platformFeeNoteCampaign: 2% of your contribution goes to Humfiverse and the other 98% into the campaign escrow. You receive every token you pay for. The 2% is not refunded if the campaign is cancelled.
buy.ackLabel: I understand this is a pilot structure, not investment advice, and I’ve reviewed the risk factors.
buy.fundsExtraCampaignNote: Buying now also funds this catalogue's video/marketing campaign: your payment is held in the milestone escrow and released only when the artist and the studio both confirm. Once that goal is met, payments are no longer escrowed — they go straight to the token contract's payout address, a single address Humfiverse sets for every catalogue rather than the artist's own.
buy.kycNote: KYC/AML verification (simulated) is required before funds settle. No crypto wallet needed — fiat on-ramp shown as a mock step.
buy.kycRequired: Identity verification and a MiFID II investor-appropriateness check are required before buying.
kyc.title: Identity & investor profile
kyc.subtitle: A one-time check before you can buy: identity verification and a MiFID II appropriateness assessment for this type of instrument. Simulated — no documents are actually collected or checked.
kyc.retailBody: Most individual investors. Gets the full set of MiFID II protections, including this appropriateness check.
kyc.professionalBody: Meets MiFID II Annex II criteria (e.g. large portfolio, financial-sector experience). Fewer protections apply, but this pilot still runs the same check.
kyc.appropriatenessSubtitle: Required under MiFID II Art. 25(3) before selling a complex, non-standard instrument like a royalty-participation note without advice. If your answers suggest the product may not be appropriate for you, we'll warn you — you can still choose to proceed.
kyc.q1: Have you previously invested in financial instruments beyond savings accounts or deposits (e.g. stocks, bonds, funds)?
kyc.q2: Are you familiar with illiquid or non-listed financial instruments?
kyc.q3: Do you understand you could lose your entire investment, and that no secondary market is guaranteed?
kyc.q4: Years of experience investing in financial instruments
kyc.sourceOfFundsLabel: Primary source of the funds you'll invest
kyc.pepLabel: I am a politically exposed person (PEP), or a family member/close associate of one.
kyc.appropriateResult: Based on your answers, this type of instrument appears appropriate for your experience level.
kyc.warningResult: Based on your answers, this instrument may not be appropriate for your experience level — it is complex and illiquid, with no guaranteed secondary market. You may still choose to proceed.
kyc.warningAckLabel: I understand this product may not be appropriate for me, and I choose to proceed anyway.
kyc.alreadyVerifiedBody: Investor classification: {{classification}}. You can proceed to buy.
success.body: You now hold {{qty}} of {{title}}, for a total of {{total}}.
portfolio.title: Your holdings
portfolio.emptyBody: Browse the marketplace to buy your first fractional royalty share.
portfolio.subtitle: Royalty income accrues here as the SPV confirms it received payment from DSPs and PROs. Connect a wallet below to pull your accrued share on-chain.
redeem.connectBody: MetaMask (or any injected EVM wallet) identifies the address your redeemed royalties are sent to.
redeem.noWalletNote: No wallet extension detected in this browser — install MetaMask to try this flow for real.
forArtists.title: Raise against your catalogue — or finance the track before it exists
forArtists.subtitle: Tokenize a released catalogue and receive 98% of every sale, or get a new track’s production funded through milestone escrow. Either way creative control stays yours: token buyers get transparency, not a seat at the mixing desk.
forArtists.feature1Body: Raised funds stay in a smart contract and unlock in tranches only when you and the studio confirm the milestone. If the platform cancels the campaign, contributors reclaim the share not yet released.
forArtists.feature2Body: Per-element disclosure (vocals, instrumentation, composition, post-production, lyrics) is captured at upload — evidence you can point to if a DSP’s classification is ever disputed.
forArtists.feature3Body: Title, amount, studio, payout wallet and milestones are signed by you at launch and stay on record with your signature.
wizard.title: Set up a royalty-token campaign
wizard.launchingNote: This can take up to a minute — minting the token and linking your audio on-chain. Please don't close this tab.
wizard.fillRequired: Fill in the required fields first.
wizBasics.title: Tell us about the track or catalogue
wizBasics.subtitle: Just enough to generate a listing preview — full metadata is collected later in a real onboarding flow.
wizBasics.descPlaceholder: What makes this catalogue or track worth financing?
wizModel.title: Which model fits this campaign?
wizModel.subtitle: This is the single biggest fork in the road — it changes the risk profile, the pitch to investors, and the compliance path.
wizModel.catalogueBody: Bond-like. Your track is already released and earning. Investors buy a share of known, reported income.
wizModel.preprodBody: Venture-like. Raise to finish an unreleased draft — session musicians, studio time, mix & master — before it exists.
wizSource.preprodSubtitle: Set your production budget, then how the raise is released, milestone by milestone.
wizRaise.priceNote: Each token will cost {{price}}: {{supply}} tokens raise {{raise}}. The smart contract sets this price at mint — the same for every token — and it cannot be changed afterwards.
wizRaise.roundedNote: The funding doesn't divide exactly by the supply, so the price is rounded down to the millionth of a dollar: the raise is {{raise}} instead of {{requested}}.
wizRaise.invalid: Enter a supply of at least 1 token and a funding amount that gives each token a price of at least $0.000001.
wizMilestones.title: Milestones
wizMilestones.hint: Choose how much of the raise each milestone releases.
wizMilestones.invalid: Every milestone needs a name, a percentage above 0, and the percentages must add up to exactly 100%.
wizMilestones.amountNote: The amount beside each milestone is its share of the goal — what investors pay for it. Humfiverse takes 2% of every contribution and 3% of each tranche when it is released.
wizMilestones.rowBreakdown: Fees {{fees}} (2% on contributions {{contribution}} + 3% on release {{milestone}}) · {{payee}} receives {{net}}
wizMilestones.summary: On a {{goal}} goal: Humfiverse fees {{fees}} in total · artist and studio receive {{net}}.
wizMilestones.flexibleHint: Decide what each tranche waits for: name every milestone after what has to be delivered, choose who it pays, and set its share.
wizMilestones.marketingToggle: Release the tranches as stages of a marketing campaign
wizMilestones.namePlaceholder: What must be delivered to release this tranche
wizSource.extraCampaignToggle: Release the funding by milestones (a video, a marketing campaign…)
wizSource.extraCampaignHint: Optional. For a track that already generates the cash flow you declared when tokenizing it, you can tie the release of the funding to milestones — such as a music video or a marketing campaign. Contributions stay locked in escrow: each milestone's tranche is released only when both you and the studio or partner confirm, each from your own wallet, that it was delivered. Without milestones, the funding is paid to your wallet as tokens sell.
wizSource.extraCampaignMilestonesNote: Each milestone is released only once you and the studio or partner both confirm it was delivered.
wizSource.catalogueSubtitle: In a real flow this is a human-in-the-loop diligence process against PRO and distributor statements. Here, a quick mock of what we’d collect.
wizSource.statementHint: PDF or CSV export from your distributor/PRO dashboard.
wizSource.audioPlaceholder: Click to upload the real audio file
wizSource.audioHint: Optional — the actual track, pinned to IPFS and linked on-chain to the token. MP3/WAV, 20MB max.
wizDisclosure.title: AI-content disclosure
wizDisclosure.subtitle: Recorded once, reused everywhere: as DDEX metadata for DSPs, and as the evidence file if a classification is ever disputed.
wizReview.title: Review & launch
wizReview.launchNote: Launching creates a listing visible in the marketplace with mock data seeded from what you entered. In a real launch this step would trigger SPV setup and legal review — nothing here is a real offering.
wizReview.walletOwner: This campaign will belong to your connected wallet {{address}}: it is how your campaigns are identified, it confirms milestones, and it receives the tranches paid to the artist.
wizReview.walletRequired: Connect your wallet to create the campaign. A campaign belongs to the wallet that creates it: that wallet identifies your campaigns, confirms milestones and receives the tranches paid to the artist.
wizReview.ackLabel: I understand this is a prototype: no real funds, tokens or legal entity are created.
wizContract.title: Milestone escrow & royalty assignment agreement
wizContract.subtitle: A standard template every artist accepts at upload — drafted in Italian, since the agreement is governed by Italian law. Read the summary below (shown in your interface language); the clauses themselves stay in Italian, the language of the actual agreement.
wizContract.languageNote: This clause text is shown as a provisional, AI-assisted translation for readability — the Italian version is the sole legally authoritative text, and prevails in case of any discrepancy.
wizContract.generalLabel: I have read and accept this Milestone Escrow & Royalty Assignment Agreement in full.
wizContract.vessatoriaIntro: The clauses below are the ones most likely to need extra scrutiny in a standard-form agreement — they require your separate, specific acceptance, not just the general checkbox above.
wizContract.draftNote: Draft prototype text, not reviewed by counsel — not a binding contract.
wizContract.requiredNote: Accept the agreement and every flagged clause to continue.
toast.contractFailed: Could not record contract acceptance — check the flagged clauses.
artistDash.title: My campaigns
artistDash.emptyBody: Launch your first campaign to see it here.
artistDash.connectBody: Your campaigns are identified by the wallet that created them. Connect it to see yours.
artistDash.holdersUnknownNote: Not tracked: counting holders means enumerating every address holding the token, which needs an indexer this prototype does not have.
artistDash.holdersIndexing: Still indexing the token transfer history — the count appears once it has caught up.

toast.noWalletDetected: No wallet connected. Sign in or connect a wallet, then try again.

toast.audioLinked: Track audio uploaded and linked on-chain.

landing.artistPanel.title: Turn your music into funding — on your terms
landing.artistPanel.body: Sell shares in a catalogue you’ve already released, or raise funds for your next track through an escrow campaign. You launch it by signing with your wallet, and creative control stays with you.
landing.artistPanel.point1: Catalogue: 98% of every sale goes straight to your wallet
landing.artistPanel.point2: Pre-production: funds unlock in tranches as you and the studio confirm each milestone
landing.artistPanel.point3: Every payment stays public and verifiable on the blockchain
landing.investorPanel.title: Back the music you love, one token at a time
landing.investorPanel.body: Buy tokens in released catalogues or contribute to a track in production. Every listing shows price, milestones, the royalty figures the artist declares and AI disclosure before you buy.
landing.investorPanel.point1: No MetaMask needed: sign in with Google, Apple or email
landing.investorPanel.point2: Tokens sit in your wallet and you can list them for resale
landing.investorPanel.point3: If a campaign is cancelled, you reclaim your share of the funds not yet released
landing.subtitle: Music royalty tokens, funds held in escrow and released by milestone, every step verifiable on-chain.
landing.ticker.5: Sign in with Google, Apple or email
landing.how.title: From track to token, all on-chain
landing.how.step1Body: The artist creates the campaign and signs it with their wallet: title, amount, studio and milestones stay on record.
landing.how.step2Body: Backers pay in USDC and receive the tokens in their own wallet. The platform fee is 2%.
landing.how.step3Body: For pre-productions the funds stay in the smart contract and are released in tranches as artist and studio confirm each milestone.
landing.how.step4Body: Tokens can be listed for resale between users, with price and fees shown before you confirm.
landing.status.title: A prototype that really works, on a test network
landing.status.live1: Sign-in with Google, Apple or email, and registration with a verified email
landing.status.live2: Token purchases and escrow contributions with test USDC
landing.status.live3: Campaign launch, royalty figures and KYC signed by the wallet
landing.status.live4: Campaign cancellation and refunds in the portfolio
landing.status.next1: Signed acceptance of the terms at registration
landing.status.next3: Cancellation with legal grounds and content takedown
landing.status.next4: New contract version: refunds per token held and multisig ownership
portfolio.sellFeeNote: The platform retains 1% of the payment on every secondary sale — never on a first purchase from the platform pool. The buyer receives every token they pay for.
portfolio.sellSuccessBody: Your {{qty}} tokens of {{title}} are listed at {{price}} each. They'll show up in the resale market — once someone buys, you receive the payment less the platform's 1% fee, and the buyer receives every token.
detail.resaleFeeNote: The platform retains 1% of the payment on every resale purchase — never on the first purchase from the platform pool. You receive every token you pay for.
detail.resaleEmpty: No one is reselling this token right now. Buy at the primary price above, or offer your own holdings below.
detail.resaleYouHold: You hold {{n}} token(s) of this campaign
detail.resaleConnectToSell: Connect your wallet to offer tokens for resale.
detail.resaleNothingToSell: You hold no tokens of this campaign to offer.
detail.resaleOfferNote: This publishes an offer. It does not lock or transfer your tokens — the marketplace contract is written but not deployed, so nothing here settles a trade. Your balance is checked once, when you list.
detail.resaleUnavailable: Resale is unavailable on this deployment — the marketplace contract is not configured.
detail.resaleApproving: Approving the marketplace to move this token…
detail.resaleNotDeliverable: Seller no longer holds these tokens
detail.resaleOnchainNote: Listing is a transaction from your own wallet. Your tokens stay with you and transfer only when someone buys. Humfiverse cannot list, cancel or move them for you.
detail.resaleListedBody: Listed {{qty}} token(s) of {{title}} at {{price}} each. The offer is now visible to everyone.
detail.resaleSuccessBody: You now hold {{received}} more tokens of {{title}}, paid {{paid}}. The platform's 1% resale fee ({{fee}}) came out of the seller's proceeds, not your tokens.
buy.onchainReady: Wallet connected — this will be a real on-chain purchase
buy.onchainConnectPrompt: Connect your wallet to make this a real on-chain purchase (otherwise it stays simulated).
buy.notOpenYet: Opens when the campaign's escrow is ready
buy.simulatedNote: Simulated. This asset has no on-chain token, so nothing was recorded on the blockchain and no tokens changed hands — only this page changed.

toast.onchainReverted: The transaction was submitted but reverted on-chain — no tokens were delivered, though a small gas fee may still apply.
wizSource.studioWalletHint: The studio-booking milestone pays this wallet directly — not you. This is what makes the commitment real, not just a promise.
toast.escrowNeedsWallet: Campaign created, but connect a wallet to set up its milestone escrow.
toast.escrowCreateFailed: Campaign created, but the on-chain escrow could not be set up right now.
buy.escrowReady: Wallet connected — this will be a real contribution held in escrow
buy.escrowConnectPrompt: Connect your wallet to make this a real contribution held in escrow (otherwise it stays simulated).
detail.escrowExplainer: Funds sit in this contract, never with the artist directly, until both the artist and the studio confirm each milestone from their own wallets — Humfiverse has no way to release a tranche on its own.
escrow.platformFeeNote: Humfiverse keeps 2% of every contribution and 3% of each tranche when it is released; the artist and the studio receive the rest. The 2% is not refunded if the campaign is cancelled, and nothing is charged on tranches that are never released.
detail.studioSelfDealingWarning: Unverified studio — the studio wallet is the same as the artist's, so one signer controls both confirmations. Milestone releases aren't independently checked for this campaign.
toast.assetSaveFailed: Campaign created, but it couldn't be saved to the server — it may not be visible to other visitors yet.
detail.onchainRecordNote: Title and artist read straight from the contract:
studio.title: Confirm a production milestone
studio.intro: If an artist named you as their studio on Humfiverse, connect the wallet they registered for you to see the campaigns tied to it and confirm milestones as they're genuinely met.
studio.notRegisteredTitle: This wallet isn't registered as a studio
studio.notRegisteredBody: Studios aren't self-signed-up — an artist registers you by entering your name and wallet address when they set up a preproduction campaign. Ask the artist you're working with to confirm they used this exact wallet address.
studio.noCampaigns: No campaigns found for this wallet yet.
artistMilestones.title: Confirm your production milestones
artistMilestones.intro: A milestone only releases once you and your studio both confirm it happened, each from your own wallet — Humfiverse has no say in it. Connect the wallet you used to create your campaign to see what's waiting on you.
artistMilestones.noCampaigns: No preproduction campaigns found for this wallet yet.

portfolio.dashboardTrendPending: No value history recorded yet — this appears after your first visit with a connected wallet.
redeem.connectBodySocial: Sign in with Google, Apple or email and a wallet is created for you — no browser extension needed. It holds your tokens and receives your royalties.
connect.title: Sign in to Humfiverse
connect.subtitle: Use an account you already have and we create your wallet. No extension, no seed phrase.
connect.subtitleConnected: You're signed in. Sign out, or use the options below to switch account or wallet.
connect.viaInApp: Signed in with Google, Apple or email
connect.eudiwSoonTitle: Sign-in with the EU Digital Identity Wallet is being prepared and is not available yet.
connect.noInjected: Already have a crypto wallet? Install MetaMask to use it here.
connect.custodyNote: With Google, Apple or email, your wallet's key is held by thirdweb in a secure enclave — not by Humfiverse, which cannot move your tokens. Network fees on Sepolia are covered by the platform.

portfolio.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select the address and copy it by hand.
portfolio.refundsIntro: These campaigns were cancelled. You can claim your share of what had not been released yet. The 2% contribution fee is not refunded, and your tokens stay in your wallet.
buy.campaignCancelled: This campaign was cancelled and no longer accepts contributions.
buy.campaignCancelledRefund: Claim a refund in your portfolio

toast.kycSubmitFailed: Your verification could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
wizSource.studioIsArtist: The studio wallet must be different from yours: each milestone needs two independent confirmations.
register.title: Verify your email
register.subtitle: It completes your registration, so we can reach you about the campaigns you create or back. We send you a 6-digit code, then you confirm with your wallet.
register.signNote: After the code your wallet asks for a signature: it links this email to your wallet and costs nothing.
register.privacyNote: We use your email only for messages about the service and never show it to anyone. Humfiverse is a prototype and has no final privacy notice yet.
register.doneBody: {{email}} is now verified and linked to your wallet.
register.gateBuy: Verify your email before buying or contributing.
register.gateKyc: Confirm your email before investor verification.
register.gateLaunch: Verify your email before launching the campaign.
register.rateLimited: Too many codes requested. Try again shortly.
register.unavailable: Email verification is not active on this server yet.
register.sendFailed: The code could not be sent. Try again.
register.codeExpired: The code expired or ran out of attempts. Ask for a new one.
register.signRejected: Signature cancelled: without it the email is not linked to your wallet.
media.hint.image: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
media.hint.video: MP4, MOV or WebM, up to 30 seconds and 25 MB.

media.managerSubtitle: Add or replace the track’s cover and video. Your wallet signs each file.
media.replaceHint: Choose a file to replace it.
media.publicNote: Files are uploaded to IPFS and are public. Only upload content you hold the rights to.
portfolio.royaltiesIntro: Royalty income deposited on the token contract, shared equally over every token. What your tokens earned stays yours even if you have sold them since.
portfolio.refundsIntroTokens: These campaigns were cancelled. You can claim your share of what had not been released yet by handing back your tokens, which are burned. The 2% contribution fee is not refunded; royalties your tokens already earned stay claimable.
royaltyPayouts.title: Royalty payouts on chain
royaltyPayouts.intro: Royalty income deposited here is split equally over every token that exists, and each holder claims their own share. Unsold tokens' share goes to the artist. The contract cannot check that a deposit matches what the track really earned: that rests on whoever deposits, and on the statement each deposit names.
royaltyPayouts.poolShare: {{amount}} belongs to the {{unsold}} unsold tokens of {{supply}} and is paid to the artist's wallet.
royaltyPayouts.depositIntro: Deposit in USDC the royalties this track earned. They are shared out at once over every token that exists.
royaltyPayouts.depositNote: Two signatures: a USDC approval, then the deposit. A deposit cannot be taken back. The statement's hash is written on chain with it.
